data.narrative:
VVater, a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Kevin Gast, has raised $5.79M to date. The comparable universe in Climate & Energy includes one public company and eight private peers, though a sufficiently tight peer cohort at the same stage and valuation tier does not exist to support a peer-median method.

Given the lack of narrow-stage comparables, the valuation relies on stage-progression analysis. Using total raised ($5.79M, rounded to $6M) as a base value proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression yields $14.5M. This method is the only quantitatively supported triangulation point available.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $12M to $17M, with a median estimate of $14M. The width of this range reflects uncertainty inherent in single-method triangulation and the absence of direct peer benchmarking. Key risks to this range include the nascent stage of the business and limited visibility into unit economics or market traction. Investors should request disclosure of capital deployment, customer pipeline, and technical milestones to refine this initial estimate.
